name: Festive Tonic Ice Doughnuts
desc: Orange juice ice rings frozen with raspberries, cranberries and rosemary, topped with blood orange tonic.

source.title: Festive Tonic Ice Doughnuts
source.evidence: Saved Instagram reel; caption and on-screen text captured in the owner's saved-recipes export

ingredients.raw: About 1 1/2 cups fresh orange juice (from 4 to 5 oranges), enough to fill the mold
ingredients.note: from 4 to 5 oranges, enough to fill the mold

ingredients.raw: 6 cups blood orange and elderflower tonic water, chilled (about 1 cup per glass)
ingredients.item: blood orange and elderflower tonic water

steps: Juice the oranges and strain out the seeds.
Set the silicone doughnut mold on a small baking sheet so it stays level. Put 3 raspberries, 3 cranberries and 2 rosemary sprigs in each cavity.
Pour orange juice over the fruit to fill each cavity. Freeze at least 6 hours or overnight, until solid.
Pop out the ice doughnuts. Put 1 in each glass and pour about 1 cup cold tonic over it.
tips: The juice amount depends on your mold's cavity size; squeeze one extra orange if you come up short.
